#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

bool can(int w, int m) {
    if (m == 0) return true;
    if (w == 1 || w == -1) {
        while (true) {
            // infinite loop
        }
    }
    int r = m % w;
    if (r == 0 || r == 1) {
        return can(w, m / w);
    }
    if (r == w - 1) {
        return can(w, (m + 1) / w);
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (can(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
